brief:
An Israeli strike killed a Palestinian at Halawa camp in northern Gaza, one of the region's largest displacement camps, medical staff said, according to Middle East Eye. The attack struck the camp, which houses thousands of displaced Palestinians fleeing violence across the territory.

No further details on the circumstances of the strike or the identity of the victim were immediately available.
dek: Israeli strike kills one Palestinian in Gaza An Israeli strike killed a Palestinian at Halawa camp, one of northern Gaza’s largest displacement camps, medical staff said, according to Al Jazeera.
title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian at northern Gaza camp
